title: Egyptian-Style Baked Oysters
description: A flavorful twist on traditional baked oysters, infused with Egyptian spices and herbs.
instructions: Rinse the oysters and pat them dry with paper towels.
In a small bowl, mix together minced garlic, ground cumin, salt, and black pepper.
Place the oysters on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Drizzle the oysters with olive oil and sprinkle the garlic-cumin mixture evenly over the top.
Squeeze the lemon juice over the oysters.
Bake the oysters in the preheated oven for 12-15 minutes, or until they are cooked through and the edges are slightly golden brown.
Garnish with chopped parsley, if desired.
